body.x: Ventev Mobile (ventev.com/mobile), the designer and manufacturer of mobile device accessories, introduced its battery products Powercell 10000, Powercell 3015 and other accessories at Digital Experience, the press party before the official opening of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Powercell 10000 works as both a portable battery and wall charger for mobile devices with a built-in micro USB cable, Apple Lightning cable, and a universal USB port. With its 10,000mAh lithium polymer battery, it can charge three devices at once with a total output of 5.2A. When plugged into the wall outlet using integrated folding AC prongs, your devices charge before the internal battery. Its total outputs is as follows: 1.8A for micro USB cable, 2.4A for Apple Lightning cable, 1.0A for USB, a total of 5.2A output.Powercell 3015 is also a portable battery and wall charger, but it has foldable AC prongs. This feature gives a slimmer exterior to this product.
